detail.longDescription: Turning long technical talks, podcasts, or demos into punchy short-form clips usually eats hours of manual editing. zhouxiaoka/autoclip is trending on GitHub—an open-source AI video clipping desktop tool in Python that splits long videos into vertical clips with auto-generated subtitles, covers, and publishing copy. https:// github.com/zhouxiaoka/autoclip # OpenSource # Python # AI # VideoEditing # GitHub
